title: 黒曜の火山口
description: Volcanic outskirts, charcoal gray porous basalt with brown ash and only sparse dull red glowing fissures. Low irregular rounded volcanic boulder walls, not brickwork. Ash-dusted dark flagstone floor with plain, chipped, ash-edged and tiny ember-crack variations. Props: obsidian rubble cluster, low vent with a very small plume, broken scorched wing statue, squat ember brazier. Boss: original fallen angel shape from the second reference, now black obsidian feather armor, burnt copper edges, sparse orange molten veins in wings and a molten orange sword. Clearly still a winged fallen angel, not a dragon. Room shape 10-by-10 square with clipped small corners, generous empty middle. Bright lava only outside the low walls in tiny pockets.

title: 不死鳥の火口
description: A volcanic crater nesting arena, warm dark maroon basalt, orange lava confined around the external rim. Low rough vesicular volcanic boulder walls with an orange underglow. Floor is quiet broad cooled lava plates with flowing rope-like stone patterns, ash-edged variants and occasional ember fissures. Props: a shallow black-rock phoenix nest with one ember egg, broken lava rock stack, low glowing vent, short charred stumps. Boss: fiery red-orange phoenix with clear graceful bird silhouette, coal-black tips on broad wings, gold chest and long flowing ember tail, redesigned from the second reference. Room is a rounded square, readable rectilinear tiles, clear middle and two wide dry entrance paths. Avoid covering floor with flames.

title: 熔岩の回廊
description: Obsidian volcanic sanctuary, deep brown-black obsidian rock, muted copper light, narrow magma channels along the outer sides only. Low horizontally layered basalt boulder walls, smooth pale ash on the upper edges. Quiet cooled lava floor with larger plate fragments and sparse thin glowing cracks. Props: short glossy obsidian shards, a low lava bubble basin, fossilized lava tree stump, squat worn horn-shaped stone altar. Boss: a proud unicorn based on second reference silhouette, now charcoal basalt hide with sparse molten seams at joints, flowing orange-red lava mane and tail, a single long glowing molten-gold horn. Four legs clearly readable, elegant equine silhouette, not a dragon or mechanical horse. Square room with two shallow side alcoves, broad flat open charge lanes.

title: 灰骨の祭場
description: Ash-covered volcanic necropolis. Low walls made of eroded black volcanic boulders with warm ash-colored exposed tops and tiny embers underneath. Matte charcoal and gray ash floor plates, footprints/eroded bone fragments only on edge variants, red fissures very sparse. Props: scorched rib-cage arch fragment kept LOW, squat funerary urn filled with embers, broken obsidian gravestone, low magma bowl altar. Boss: a humanoid skeletal reaper based on second reference, dark charred bones with glowing orange joints and eye sockets, furnace ember core in rib cage, big black iron scythe with a narrow orange-red molten cutting edge, sparse torn ash-gray cloth. Preserve recognizable skeleton, not armored knight. Clipped-corner 10-by-10 ritual hall, a faint unlit worn circular engraving at middle, boss and player far enough apart, floor mostly empty.

title: 大火口・炉心の玉座
description: Final volcanic foundry arena on a wide octagonal cooled basalt island above a magma sea. Low dark basalt boulder parapets with molten seams and scorched iron braces, open dry south entrance bridge. Quiet large dark floor plates with cooled rope-lava edging, plain variants and sparse hot crack variants, central floor has faint warm circular forge engraving with plenty of contrast for actors. Props: two squat black obsidian furnace pillars with orange cores at rear corners, low anvil of volcanic stone, giant broken gear half-buried at edge, magma spill trough behind the rear wall. Boss: redesign the EXISTING squat heavy furnace king mechanical Titan in second reference: broad huge iron fists, round orange furnace core in chest, black volcanic rock armor on shoulders, muted brass rivets, glowing molten seams and two small exhaust vents. Recognizable original Titan, not a different animal. Imposing but only twice player height in room. Lava remains outside dry combat platform, no huge fire effects covering actors.
